heading: iPhone 18 Pro deals you can grab to buy it cheaper
paragraphs: iPhone 18 Pro is now available on sale in India. You can buy it online or offline through Apple Stores and authorised retail partners.
The phone has launched in India at a starting price of Rs 1,64,900 for the 256GB variant.

While sales are now live, Apple says the iPhone 18 Pro has limited availability in some markets, with certain configurations facing longer delivery times. In India, some orders are showing delivery timelines extending into October.
If you have your eyes on grabbing Apple’s latest flagship, the company is offering several deals that can help bring down the cost of the iPhone 18 Pro in India.
Buyers can get up to Rs 7,000 cashback when they use eligible bank cards, bringing the effective price down to Rs 1,57,900 after cashback.

Apple is also offering its Trade In programme, allowing buyers to exchange an eligible old smartphone for additional savings. The exact exchange value depends on the phone model and its condition. Buyers can also opt for up to six months of No-Cost EMI on eligible cards.

Apple is also offering Personal Setup for customers who purchase directly from its stores. If you are upgrading from an older iPhone, combining the cashback with the trade-in value can significantly reduce the amount you pay upfront.
Do note that the maximum exchange value is not guaranteed and depends on Apple’s assessment of your old device.
As for the phone itself, the iPhone 18 Pro comes with Apple’s new A20 Pro chip, a variable-aperture main camera, a smaller Dynamic Island and battery improvements.
It also features a 6.3-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display with ProMotion, making it one of the company’s most powerful Pro iPhones yet.
